commits.message:
docs: clarify trait implementations in core module

Add comprehensive docstrings to all public traits and their methods:

- Add docstrings to LateLintPass trait method implementations across
  all lint passes (SorobanStorageInLoop, LoopInvariantStorageAccess,
  UnnecessaryHostFunctionCall, HostInLoop, UnnecessaryStringToBytes,
  BytesAppendInLoop, InefficientBytesConcat, MapInsertInLoop,
  SignatureVerificationInLoop, StorageWriteWithoutRead,
  StorageKeyConstructionInLoop, VecWhereSliceCouldBeUsed, etc.)
- Add docstrings to Visitor trait method implementations
  (CalleeStorageDetector, ParamHirIdCollector, ParamReadCheck,
  ReadVisitor, WriteVisitor)
- Add docstrings to public struct types (Cli, Span, LintFinding,
  SarifReport, SarifRun, SarifTool, etc.)
- Add docstrings to Config and its methods
- Fix missing closing brace in load_budget_config function

Closes #203
